t: Why Are Fewer Young People Buying Homes When They Leave Their Parents’ Place? | Urban Institute
s: April 2, 2025 - As homes have become more unaffordable, more young adults plan to get family support to buy a home. According to a nationally representative Redfin survey, 36 percent of young Americans plan to use cash from their family to fund a down payment on a home in 2024—double the share in 2019.
